test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A snake in the grass

options.text: A man with a straightforward attitude

solution:
The correct answer is:** A secret or hidden enemy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"A snake in the grass"** means a person who pretends to be your friend but is actually an enemy. (छिपा हुआ दुश्मन)

 
 
• **Example:** Be careful of John; he is a **snake in the grass**, always ready to betray you.
 
 
 
• **"A secret or hidden enemy"** refers to someone who secretly works against you, pretending to be your ally. (छिपा हुआ शत्रु)

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **A worthless person** (बेकार व्यक्ति): Someone who is considered to have no value or use.

 
 
• **Example:** He was dismissed as **a** **worthless person** who contributed nothing to the team.
 
 
 
• **A man of ability** (कुशल व्यक्ति): Someone who has skills and competence.
 
 
• **Example:** He is **a man of ability**, always delivering excellent results.
 
 
 
• **A man with a straightforward attitude** (सीधे-सादे स्वभाव वाला व्यक्ति): Someone who is honest and direct.
 
 
• **Example:** You can trust him; he is **a man with a straightforward attitude**.
 
 

174:Tcc0,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
